instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace index.html opening tag with <html lang='es' class='dark'> and set title 'Taller San Román | Mecánica General y Urgencias 24hs Berisso'.
2. In frontend/src/index.css, configure the dark theme tokens (#0B0C0E background, #F5C518 yellow, #FF3D2E red, #25D366 WhatsApp). Use Anton (or sans-serif high-impact display font) and Archivo.
3. Build all components with mobile-first mindset: touch targets at least 48px high for CTAs, direct links to wa.me with prefilled message 'Hola Gabriel, necesito ayuda con mi vehículo...'.
4. NO contact form — as specified, only direct WhatsApp and Call buttons.
5. Embed schema.org/AutoRepair LocalBusiness JSON-LD in the page head or layout for Berisso SEO.
6. Include the floating WhatsApp button with an urgent badge and pulse effect on the bottom right.
7. Include all 5 gallery photos with custom industrial borders and tags.
8. Ensure every CTA has proper test attributes (data-testid) for automated testing.
